cases.name: Sophie Olejnik
cases.about: She was an 8th-grader at Manville Junior High School and her mother described her as an angel and neighbors said she was "an extremely nice girl, very friendly."
cases.narrative: On 6/08/1963, a group of boys looking for frogs discovered her body she was face down in six inches of water in Royce Brook in Hillsborough, NJ. She had been on her way from her home to a dance. She was drowned forcibly by her head being held in mud and the creek, and mud and sand were found in her mouth. Her blouse was ripped open in front and her peddle-pusher / toreador-style pants partly pulled down but no penetrative rape was reported or determined. She had been sexually molested according to a news article at that time. Another article said, due to decomposition, they could not determine if she had been sexually assaulted.
